correctness.rationale: The semigroup calculation proves R=C+Cu+(u,v)^2. Integral closure is C[u,v] and its intrinsic conductor has radical (u,v). Every R-automorphism uniquely lifts and fixes the origin, with first coordinate having no v-linear term. Conversely these exact jet conditions preserve R in both directions. The derivative homomorphism splits through lower-triangular linear maps; contraction to derivative proves connectedness and explicit shear/linear maps give the two orbits. Exact symbolic checks confirm the presentation and representative cases; all-parameter proof is algebraic.

value.rationale: This explicitly solves the full automorphism-group structure for Selin’s natural isolated-singularity counterexample, beyond showing its root-generated subgroup is proper. The intrinsic first-jet constraint, split first-derivative quotient and connectedness explain which hidden automorphisms exist, and give a usable complete membership criterion. This addresses the source’s stated open third-case structural question for a canonical one-hole test object, not an arbitrary small numerical case.
